objectives:
"This Semester: This course introduces fundamental concepts of Computer Science/Engineering. In addition, the class will discuss basic programming skills. Python and C++ language will be taught. The following outline is from the main textbook. This course outline could be changed if time is not allowed to complete all lectures. Additional lectures for term projects and assignments could be added to the outline.

Winter Break: You need to study a part of Java Programming

Next Semester (Introduction to Computer Science II): Finishing C++ programming, Java Programming"
content:
"In each week, the class will discuss fundamental CS concepts for one hour, plus programming skills for two hours. The lab experiment class (i.e., Introduction to Computer Science Lab I and II) will discuss skills to complete assignments and projects. Lectures are given in English and Mandarin.

The following outline for Computer Science Fundamentals is for both Introduction to Computer Science Ⅰand II (which will be taught in the Spring semester):
1. Introduction
2. Number System
3. Data Storage
4. Operation on Data
5. Computer Organization
6. Computer Networks
7. Operating Systems
8. Algorithms
9. Programming Languages
10. Software Engineering
11. Data Structure
12. Abstract Data Type
13. File Structure
14. Databases
15. Data Compression
16. Security
17. Theory of Computation
18. Artificial Intelligent
19. Intro. to Social Media
20. Social and Ethical Issues

Four Class Modules for Programming
Module I: Practice of Python Programming
Module II: Foundation of Structured Programming (C and C++)
Module III: Foundation of Object-Oriented Programming (C++ and Java)
Module IV: Window Programming and Term Project
